Christopher Medlock James decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 69.72% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Partner Fund Management Lp sold 729,926 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.63% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Christopher Medlock James held 316,941 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $27.11 million, down from 1.05 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Partner Fund Management Lp who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $746.62 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.28% or $0.275 during the last trading session, reaching $97.175. About 7.20 million shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 37.43% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.88% the S&P500.
Trust Company Of Virginia increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 5.62% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Trust Company Of Virginia bought 5,133 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 96,539 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.34M, up from 91,406 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trust Company Of Virginia who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $923.80 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.81% or $1.51 during the last trading session, reaching $187.95. About 10.01 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
